description.value: Kung Fu Noodle is a Chinese noodle restaurant in Vancouver's Kingsway neighbourhood, specializing in northern Chinese cuisine including hand-pulled Lanzhou beef noodle soup, dim sum, and a range of chow mein and rice dishes. The menu spans a wide variety from spicy Sichuan-style fish and beef dishes to milder stir-fries and dumplings, giving hungry cyclists plenty of hearty refuelling options. Online ordering for pickup is available.
